MSc research | In progress

Sepedi-English text generation

The problem

Limited code-switched training data and vocabulary coverage make natural text generation difficult for underrepresented languages such as Sepedi.

My contribution

I investigate data-scarcity effects using Sepedi-English radio-news text, preparing the corpus, training language models and comparing their generated outputs.

Technologies and approach

Python and TensorFlow / Keras; text preprocessing and tokenisation; FNet and LSTM experiments, with mBERT in the broader research scope. Consistent dataset splits and BLEU / ROUGE evaluation support comparison.

What it delivers

The work produces model comparisons and generated-text examples to examine the effects of corpus size, English coverage and unknown tokens. I also co-authored published research with Thipe I. Modipa on Sepedi-English generation using FNet.

Current status

The MSc investigation is ongoing. Published work and continuing MSc experiments are distinct research outputs.
